messages:
laura.partnerships: FYI partner SI (OrionSI) pushed a new integration with ACME marketplace that accidentally mirrored partner credits. The result: two customer reservations got their credit buckets doubled and one of our committed Dedicated slots in eu-central is over-allocated. Noticed during capacity reconcile. :grimacing:
tom.ops: Ugh. I see allocation conflicts in the control plane for cluster eu-central-2, allocation IDs A-98123 and A-98124. Both show partner_credit_source: [acme, orionsi]. Suspect webhook duplication from the SI integration.
partnerbot-acme: partner-notice: ACME marketplace webhook delivered manifest update 2026-02-18T10:14Z for sku RD-DDED-16.
naveen.logistics: Complicating this: one of the physical shipments tied to the commit (manifest #FRA-572) is in customs hold in Frankfurt for certificate mismatch. Customs says missing CE paperwork; carrier ETA unknown. That shipment contained 6 racks earmarked for eu-central.
emily.pmo: Customers with impacted commitments: AcmeGames (SLA: reserved by 2026-02-19 EOD) and FinScale (SLA: reserved by 2026-02-20). Both are flagged high-touch. Claire, can we surface communications?
claire.sales: Yes. I'll prepare a holding note with credit options. Need clear remediation plan first though so we don't overpromise.
laura.partnerships: Action plan suggestion: 1) @tom.ops remove ORIONSI mapping on partner credit webhook to stop duplication; 2) @tom.ops run a reconciliation to revert duplicated credits and free the over-allocated slots; 3) @naveen.logistics escalate customs docs with freight forwarder and legal; 4) prep contingency: if FRA hold >12h we swap 4 racks from our parity pool in NL and prioritize network hops.
tom.ops: I can unmap the SI webhook. Command (ops):
```
redwoodctl partners webhooks unbind --partner orionsi --target acme-marketplace --dry-run
```
I'll run dry-run then unbind if it looks safe.
partnerbot-acme: partner-response: ACME support assigned ticket ACME-4477. Will review webhooks and confirm if manifest duplication originated on our side.
laura.partnerships: Good — keep us posted. @tom.ops after unbind do a forced allocation reconcile:
```
redwoodctl allocations reconcile --region eu-central --force --reason "si-dup-credits"
```
We need to ensure customers' commitments are honored and any credits reversed are tracked.
tom.ops: Dry-run unbind completed, shows ORIONSI webhook delivered identical payloads twice in last 3h. Proceeding with unbind now.
partnerbot-acme: partner-update: ACME triage found duplicate webhook deliveries from their gateway; patch rolling. ETA 20m.
claire.sales: If duplicates are reverted, can we keep customer-facing comms to a minimum? I'd still like to send an advisory that we're monitoring and include contingency credit in case schedule shifts.
naveen.logistics: Meanwhile I've pushed customs docs with the forwarder and legal; carrier says they can clear in 4-10 hours if paperwork accepted, else it may go to secondary inspection and add 24-48h. I'm prepping the NL parity swap manifest now.
emily.pmo: Timeline check: tom will finish reconcile in ~30m, ACME patch ETA 20m, customs uncertain 4-48h. Recommend we promise a status update to customers within 2 hours and avoid SLA credit decisions until we know customs outcome.
laura.partnerships: Agreed. I'll draft the customer note with holding language and a provisional credit formula but annotate it as contingent. Claire, ping me when you have the draft and I'll review.
tom.ops: Reconcile done. Over-alloc freed for allocation IDs A-98123/A-98124. Ran an audit log export and saved to /logs/partner-reconcile/1779998881-audit.csv. Rolling alerts cleared.
partnerbot-acme: partner-notice: ACME gateway patch deployed; duplicate webhook delivery stopped at 2026-02-18T10:38Z.
claire.sales: Draft ready and shared in DM. Keeping credit option capped to 10% of monthly commit for holding cases.
naveen.logistics: Customs cleared one rack with corrected CE paperwork; carrier ETA for released units to our eu-central staging is 6 hours. Still holding 3 racks pending inspection.
emily.pmo: Ok update plan: send customer status at +2h, include warm-routing contingency if customs >12h (swap NL racks), and commit to concrete credits only if we miss SLA window.
laura.partnerships: Closing loop: 1) duplicate-credit issue remediated (thanks @tom.ops). 2) ACME acknowledged gateway duplicates and patched. 3) customs partially resolved; logistics continuing. 4) comms draft in flight. I'll escalate to partnerships lead if any of the three outstanding items slip beyond the windows discussed. Keeping channel updated. :white_check_mark:
